target: Promised-calendar-date lateness among valid, observed delivered orders
source_timezone: Unspecified local source timestamps; no invented UTC conversion
probability_calibration: One fixed sigmoid of the final model's raw log odds; fit only on the later calibration/development cohort
diagnostic_threshold: Maximize F2 only on calibration/development data; this is not a capacity or cost guarantee
global_prior: Beta(1,1); never estimated from future or whole-dataset prevalence
evaluation_rule: Choose the candidate on selection validation only. Refit once, calibrate and set the diagnostic threshold before evaluating the holdout. Holdout outcomes never select models, hyperparameters, features, calibration method or threshold.
historical_replay: Model parameters are frozen before August. Rolling history may update with an outcome only after that order's observed delivery, strictly before the current approval.
coverage_limit: Evaluation is conditional on usable, observed delivery outcomes before each stated cutoff. Unknown, cancelled and incomplete outcomes are not labeled on time. Coverage and excluded counts are reported.
as_of_assumptions: The final source basket, quoted freight and promised date are assumed to match their approval-time values; the source has no revision log.
Catalog attributes and postcode centroids are treated as available static reference data; historical versions are unavailable.
Payment aggregates, carrier handover, actual delivery, reviews and final order status are excluded from model inputs.
Dates are simulated historical availability cutoffs; actual training occurs now on the laptop, not in 2018.
